what: On hover over the pill button, an accent ring is painted once around the border starting at 3 o’clock (90°) in .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), and the text color turns accent in .45s. The text rolls up one line on the same curve in .45s and changes to the same text. The thin arrow half-hanging over the button’s right end folds its line to the right and vanishes, its head shrinks to .3×, and in its place three dots blink on a 1.1s cycle, each .18s later

options.--fx-ring: Ring and dot color (via style), default --kf-accent
options.--fx-ink: Letter color (via style), default --kf-ink · on hover --fx-hover (default --kf-accent)

use: Contact Us — The arrow attaches right after the button (outside) and half-overlaps the right end of the wrapping cell

from.where: Send inquiry · sub-section contact link · footer link (.ring-button)
